messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Loan Approval Process.
New loan applications arrive every 10 minutes on average (exponential inter-arrival distribution).
Steps:
1. Receive Application - service task, fixed 2 minutes, no resource needed.
2. Credit Check - service task, normal distribution mean 15 min std 3 min,
   performed by Credit Analyst. 2 Credit Analysts available.
3. Review Decision - exclusive gateway:
   - 70%: Approved -> Prepare Offer
   - 30%: Rejected -> Send Rejection
4. Prepare Offer - user task, uniform 10-20 min, Loan Officer (1 available).
5. Send Rejection - service task, fixed 5 min, no resource.
Both paths end at: Application Closed. Simulate for 8 hours.

content.text:
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:bpsim="http://www.bpsim.org/schemas/1.0"
                  id="Definitions_LoanApproval"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <!-- Resource Definitions -->
  <bpmn:resource id="Resource_CreditAnalyst" name="Credit Analyst" />
  <bpmn:resource id="Resource_LoanOfficer" name="Loan Officer" />

  <!-- Process Definition -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LoanApproval" name="Loan Approval Process" isExecutable="true">
    
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" name="Application Received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_StartToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_StartToReceive" sourceRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="ServiceTask_ReceiveApplication" />

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_ReceiveApplication" name="Receive Application">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_StartToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_ReceiveToCredit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_ReceiveToCredit" sourceRef="ServiceTask_ReceiveApplication" targetRef="ServiceTask_CreditCheck" />

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_CreditCheck" name="Credit Check">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_ReceiveToCredit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_CreditToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:potentialOwner id="PotentialOwner_CreditAnalyst">
        <bpmn:resourceRef>Resource_CreditAnalyst</bpmn:resourceRef>
      </bpmn:potentialOwner>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_CreditToGateway" sourceRef="ServiceTask_CreditCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewDecision" name="Review Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_CreditToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_Approved" name="Approved (70%)" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" targetRef="UserTask_PrepareOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_Rejected" name="Rejected (30%)" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" targetRef="ServiceTask_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_PrepareOffer" name="Prepare Offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_OfferToClosed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:potentialOwner id="PotentialOwner_LoanOfficer">
        <bpmn:resourceRef>Resource_LoanOfficer</bpmn:resourceRef>
      </bpmn:potentialOwner>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_SendRejection" name="Send Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SequenceFlow_RejectionToClosed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_OfferToClosed" sourceRef="UserTask_PrepareOffer" targetRef="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_RejectionToClosed" sourceRef="ServiceTask_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed" name="Application Closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_OfferToClosed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SequenceFlow_RejectionToClosed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- BPMN Diagram Layout -->
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_LoanApproval">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_LoanApproval" bpmnElement="Process_LoanApproval">
      
      <!-- Start Event -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived">
        <dc:Bounds x="152" y="182" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="143" y="225" width="54" height="27" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Receive Application -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="ServiceTask_ReceiveApplication_di" bpmnElement="ServiceTask_ReceiveApplication">
        <dc:Bounds x="240" y="160" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Credit Check -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="ServiceTask_CreditCheck_di" bpmnElement="ServiceTask_CreditCheck">
        <dc:Bounds x="390" y="160" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Exclusive Gateway -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Gateway_ReviewDecision_di" bpmnElement="Gateway_ReviewDecision" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="545" y="175" width="50" height="50" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="529" y="145" width="82" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Prepare Offer -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="UserTask_PrepareOffer_di" bpmnElement="UserTask_PrepareOffer">
        <dc:Bounds x="670" y="100" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Send Rejection -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="ServiceTask_SendRejection_di" bpmnElement="ServiceTask_SendRejection">
        <dc:Bounds x="670" y="240" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- End Event -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed_di" bpmnElement="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed">
        <dc:Bounds x="832" y="182" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="823" y="225" width="54" height="27" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- Sequence Flows -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="SequenceFlow_StartToReceive_di" bpmnElement="SequenceFlow_StartToReceive">
        <di:waypoint x="188" y="200" />
        <di:waypoint x="240" y="200" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="SequenceFlow_ReceiveToCredit_di" bpmnElement="SequenceFlow_ReceiveToCredit">
        <di:waypoint x="340" y="200" />
        <di:waypoint x="390" y="200" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="SequenceFlow_CreditToGateway_di" bpmnElement="SequenceFlow_CreditToGateway">
        <di:waypoint x="490" y="200" />
        <di:waypoint x="545" y="200" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="SequenceFlow_Approved_di" bpmnElement="SequenceFlow_Approved">
        <di:waypoint x="570" y="175" />
        <di:waypoint x="570" y="140" />
        <di:waypoint x="670" y="140" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="576" y="123" width="78" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="SequenceFlow_Rejected_di" bpmnElement="SequenceFlow_Rejected">
        <di:waypoint x="570" y="225" />
        <di:waypoint x="570" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint x="670" y="280" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="578" y="283" width="74" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="SequenceFlow_OfferToClosed_di" bpmnElement="SequenceFlow_OfferToClosed">
        <di:waypoint x="770" y="140" />
        <di:waypoint x="850" y="140" />
        <di:waypoint x="850" y="182" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="SequenceFlow_RejectionToClosed_di" bpmnElement="SequenceFlow_RejectionToClosed">
        <di:waypoint x="770" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint x="850" y="280" />
        <di:waypoint x="850" y="218" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>

    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>

  <!-- BPSim Simulation Parameters -->
  <bpmn:relationship type="BPSimData">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpsim:BPSimData>
        <bpsim:Scenario id="Scenario_1" name="Loan Approval 8-Hour Simulation">
          <bpsim:ScenarioParameters duration="PT8H" timeUnit="min" />
          
          <!-- Inter-arrival Rate: Exponential mean 10 min -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:WaitTime>
                <bpsim:ExponentialDistribution mean="10.0" />
              </bpsim:WaitTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <!-- 1. Receive Application: Fixed 2 min -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="ServiceTask_ReceiveApplication">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:NormalDistribution mean="2.0" standardDeviation="0.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <!-- 2. Credit Check: Normal mean 15 min, std 3 min -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="ServiceTask_CreditCheck">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:NormalDistribution mean="15.0" standardDeviation="3.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Selection>
                <bpsim:Quantity>1</bpsim:Quantity>
              </bpsim:Selection>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <!-- Branching Probabilities -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="SequenceFlow_Approved">
            <bpsim:ControlParameters>
              <bpsim:Probability>0.70</bpsim:Probability>
            </bpsim:ControlParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="SequenceFlow_Rejected">
            <bpsim:ControlParameters>
              <bpsim:Probability>0.30</bpsim:Probability>
            </bpsim:ControlParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <!-- 4. Prepare Offer: Uniform 10-20 min -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="UserTask_PrepareOffer">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:UniformDistribution min="10.0" max="20.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Selection>
                <bpsim:Quantity>1</bpsim:Quantity>
              </bpsim:Selection>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <!-- 5. Send Rejection: Fixed 5 min -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="ServiceTask_SendRejection">
            <bpsim:TimeParameters>
              <bpsim:ProcessingTime>
                <bpsim:NormalDistribution mean="5.0" standardDeviation="0.0" />
              </bpsim:ProcessingTime>
            </bpsim:TimeParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <!-- Resources Availability -->
          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="Resource_CreditAnalyst">
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Amount>2</bpsim:Amount>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

          <bpsim:ElementParameters elementRef="Resource_LoanOfficer">
            <bpsim:ResourceParameters>
              <bpsim:Amount>1</bpsim:Amount>
            </bpsim:ResourceParameters>
          </bpsim:ElementParameters>

        </bpsim:Scenario>
      </bpsim:BPSimData>
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:relationship>

</bpmn:definitions>
```
